A CHARMED WYVERN WITH NO LOCK NEVER LEAVES ITS ATTACK STATE - THE ONLY `sub_1ED30` CALLER WITH NO NULL ARM: `sub_24510` (EF:15451, the (5,16) action-130 body) resolves its lock through `sub_1ED30`, whose StageVar2==14 branch decrements the charm clock `word_0x2E_46` (EXE 0x43670 `dec; jle`) and returns `Entities[0]` when the clock is <= 0, when the lock IS the parent, or when the parent's own lock/attacker names somebody else. Nine callers exit the attack state on that null; the wyvern's does nothing - `if (iz > Entities[0]) {...}` then the epilogue (EXE 0x48e0a `jbe 0x48fc3`). Charmed mid-attack with lock 0 (previous fixture), the five wyverns therefore stay in 130 forever: `sub_1E9C0`'s expiry lives in the state-7 wrapper, `sub_12500`'s snap skips phase 2, damage only rewrites the lock. The port dropped to 129 (retail 130) on the null pointer and its head clock would later EXPIRE them in phase 2. WITNESS mc2l17 pair 26941->26942: slots 1/2/3/5/7 retail action 130 / port 129, f2e 607 -> 606 on both sides once the clock lives in the resolver. The same seven wyverns run their clocks negative (slot 8 to -11,806) until the player kills them - the retail bug the default-on patch `mc2_wyvern_alliance_brain` removes (docs/DEVIATIONS.md).

THE CHARM CLOCK LAPSING MID-ATTACK EXPIRES NOTHING ON A WYVERN: the port's head clock (`mc2_alliance_clock`, the `sub_1E9C0` paraphrase run in every state) took the wyvern to StageVar2 10 / owner 0 the tick `word_0x2E_46` reached 0; retail's `sub_1E9C0` is the state-7 wrapper's body and never runs in action 130, where `sub_1ED30` alone counts the clock and keeps answering null. WITNESS mc2l17 slot 8, charmed at t=11964 while attacking the human (lock 0 from the conversion), pair 12573->12574: retail f2e 1 -> 0, sv2 14, owner 91, action 130 - and the same lanes every tick after, the clock at -11,806 when it dies at t=24423.

THE MC2 MANA CENSUS CREDITS ITS RUNAWAY OWNER TAG AT @0x8C, AND THE PORT'S `f136` IS @0x8C ONLY FOR THE UNIFORM RECORD: `sub_61000` (EF:62388; both `e8` call sites are inside the census `sub_60F00`, NETHERW.EXE file 0x857c0 / 0x857e7) is four instructions - 0x85807 `mov 0x94(%ebx),%dx` (the owner tag), `test`/`je` past it on 0, 0x85818 `mov 0x1a3e4(,%eax,4),%eax` (&Entities[tag]), 0x8581f `mov 0x90(%ebx),%edx`, and 0x85825 `add %edx,0x8c(%eax)`. There is NO class, model, life or reap test on the target - the tag word alone picks the record - and the only reset walks the PLAYER TABLE (file 0x8572b), so a tag naming a non-wizard accumulates forever: the MC2 twin of MC1's (10,40) grave (`no_mc1_mana_census_wrap`). The port ported that faithfully and wrote `e.f136`. *** THE BUG IS THE FIELD HOME, NOT THE BEHAVIOUR ***: `import_ent_mc2`'s class-15 block RE-HOMES the manifestation's fields (`f136` = @0x88, `max_life` = @0x8C) and the m27 hydra keeps its bolt power in `f136` too, so on a spell manifestation the credit landed in the class-15 upkeep lane and the graded @0x8C never moved. WHEN A LAW READS OR WRITES A FIELD BY PORT NAME, CHECK WHETHER THE IMPORTER RE-HOMES THAT FIELD FOR THE TARGET'S CLASS. WITNESS mc2l17 pair 15059->15060, slot 4 - a wizard's dormant (15,0) manifestation (owner 147) named by two loose (10,39) mana spheres (slots 491 and 529, 1,100 of `mana` each) whose @0x94 still points at it: from the ctor's 100 retail steps `mana_max` by exactly +2,200 a tick (2300 here, on to t=15,255 - 194 first-divergence rows, the take's dominant lane) and the port held 100. `mana_max` is the pair's ONLY dirty lane; sum(`mana`) over every @0x94==slot record reproduces retail's step to the unit on every tick. mc2l18 slot 3 (owner 483, eight spheres, 9,970) is the same law and its run ENDS on the tick the last sphere is collected. A/B: `MGC_NO_MC2_CENSUS_CREDIT_HOME=1` re-reds this pair; mc2l17 469 -> 275 segments. The law's (5,27) rider - the hydra arm SKIPS the credit rather than inflating its bolt power - measures exactly zero on this corpus and is UNWITNESSED.

THE CREATURE WALK'S ROSTER PREDICATE HAS THREE CLAUSES, NOT TWO - A SHOT DOES NOT ACQUIRE ITS OWN CASTER'S CHARMED ALLY. ⭐⭐⭐ THIS IS THE SAME THIRD CLAUSE AS `a-turret-does-not-shoot-its-owners-own-charmed-creature`, ON A SECOND CALL PATH - A LAW ON ONE CALL PATH IS NOT LANDED. `sub_67CB0`'s per-model walk (EF:55265-69 `case 9`; the identical clause at EF:55159-63 and EF:55312-16 `case 0x10`) reads `cand->id_0x1A != shot->id_0x1A && cand->byte_0x39_57 && (cand->StageVar2_0x49_73 != 14 || cand->parentId_0x28_40 != shot->id_0x1A)`. The port kept the first two clauses and dropped the third. `NETHERW.EXE` file 0x8C570 (VA 0x67D70), identified as `case 9` by its own operands (`minSpeed*maxLife` at 0x8C4FC, the `cmpl $0x1d` bucket loop at 0x8C5BB, `push $0x200` pitch cone at 0x8C594): `mov 0x1a(%esi),%ax` / `cmp 0x1a(%ebx),%ax` / `je` · `cmpb $0x0,0x39(%esi)` / `je` · **`cmpb $0xe,0x49(%esi)` / `jne 0x8c594`** / `xor %edx,%edx` / `movswl 0x1a(%ebx),%eax` / `mov 0x28(%esi),%dx` / `cmp %eax,%edx` / **`je 0x8c5ae`** - my own ally, SKIP. ⚠ `case 0x19` (the (9,25) alliance carrier, EF:55334-46) is the ONE arm that does NOT carry the clause - it screens with `sub_3A7F0` instead - hence the `charm_eligible` guard on the port's arm. WITNESS mc2l17 pair 27217->27218: the human (carpet 91) releases a charged tier-0 Lightning (`charge` 162 -> 1). Retail's beam lands at slot 289 with `word_0x96_150` = **0** - its acquisition found NOTHING - and flies the caster's own 1745/1957, walking 10 steps and laying an 81-node trail. The port locked slot 5, a `(5,16)` wyvern with `StageVar2 = 14` and `parentId_0x28_40 = 91`, the human's OWN charmed creature; it snapped to 1798/1938, walked only 8 steps and laid its trail down the wrong ray. This pair records **fifteen `(9,9)` trail nodes MISSING in the port** plus the `(10,23)` blast at slot 396. ⭐ Tier 0 is RAPID, so it re-fires every tick and ONE wrong predicate generated a 130-tick burst: the take's `(9,9)` x108, `(10,23)` x112, `(9,3)` x72 and `(10,0)` x41 head families are ALL downstream of this single decision - COUNT DECISIONS, NOT ROWS. A/B: `MGC_NO_MC2_AIM_ALLY=1` re-reds it; mc2l17 goes 259 -> 75 segments on this law alone (112 reversion-probe candidates, 0 lost), and the 400-tick slice t=27,000..27,400 - 112 heads at baseline - becomes BIT-EXACT.

THE ALLIANCE PARENT SEAT DIES WITH THE RECORD, NOT WITH THE CREATURE. `sub_1E9C0` clears `parentId_0x28_40` on exactly ONE leg - the charm's EXPIRY (EF:11019-22, which sets `StageVar2 = 10`, `word_0x96_150 = 0` and `parentId = 0` together) - and NOTHING clears it on death: a killed-but-unreaped record keeps its owner word until `NewEvent_4A050` overwrites the slot. The port's parent rides the `mc2_allied` side map and `mc2_alliance_clock`'s dead guard dropped it the moment `life` went negative, so `obs_project_mc2` - which reads `owner28` for a class-5 `site_z == 14` record straight out of that map - published 0. The seat is now dropped in `Gen::new_event` instead, beside the `mc2_aura_claim` drop that is its exact precedent. WITNESS mc2l17 pair 24423->24424, wyvern slot 8, a `(5,16)` at action 133: **`owner` retail 91, port 0**, and that single row IS the pair. The record is dead (`life` -1012) and NOT reaped (`flags` 12, so not even a ghost) with `word_0x2E_46` = -11,806 - ⭐ the state-7 expiry can never run on a wyvern (cf. `mc2_wyvern_alliance_brain`), so retail simply holds `owner28 = 91` for the nine ticks between the kill and the reap. Seven more wyverns (slots 1/2/3/5/6/7/11) repeat it, which is the take's fifty single-row `(5,16) owner` heads. A/B: `MGC_NO_MC2_ALLY_SEAT_RECYCLE=1` re-reds it (45 reversion-probe candidates, 0 lost); with the aim-ally law it takes mc2l17 75 -> 26 segments. ⚠ `Mc2SlotMap` IS hashed (transparent while empty), so this law changes when an entry leaves `Gen` state - the full gate was re-run and NO GOLDEN MOVED (1,210 tests, 0 failed).
